title: THE LINE THROUGH WHICH BLESSING CAME

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Judah's sons were Er and Onan, but they died in Canaan. The descendants of Judah by their clans were: through Shelah, the Shelanite clan; through Perez, the Perezite clan; through Zerah, the Zerahite clan... These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500. - Num 26:19-22 (NIV, abridged)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The tribe of Judah is now counted, and it stands out as the largest, numbering seventy-six thousand and more. But the greatness of Judah is not merely in its numbers. This was the royal tribe, the line through which God would one day bring the promised King. Every name recorded here belonged to a family carrying forward a hope larger than they knew.

We even see the frailty of this line. Judah's sons Er and Onan had died in Canaan because of their wickedness. The royal line was not without sin and failure. Yet God preserved it, working His purposes through imperfect people, keeping alive the family from which the Messiah would come.

This is how God so often works: not through the flawless, but through ordinary and even failing people whom He sustains by grace. The line of Judah continued not because of human merit but because of God's faithful purpose. He was guiding history toward the coming of His Son.

For from Judah, in the fullness of time, came Jesus, the Lion of the tribe of Judah (Rev 5:5). These names in the census were links in the chain leading to the Saviour of the world. What looks like a simple list is part of the great story of redemption. Marvel at the God who wove salvation through such ordinary families, and give thanks for the King who came.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How does God's use of imperfect people encourage you?
2. What does it mean that Christ came from the tribe of Judah?
3. How does seeing God's redemptive purpose change how you read these lists?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that through the ordinary and imperfect line of Judah You brought the Saviour of the world. I praise You for Jesus, the Lion of Judah, in whom all Your promises are fulfilled. Amen.
